description: Fetches a Figma node and its rendered image from the Figma API and converts it to a code block. Requires FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable to be set.

figmaNodeUrl.description: The URL of the Figma node (e.g., https://www.figma.com/design/fileKey/fileName?node-id=123-456)

name: convert-figma-to-code
